variables.name: socket
variables.comment:
* The application layer socket. Either an {@link SSLSocket} layered over {@link #rawSocket}, or
   * {@link #rawSocket} itself if this connection does not use SSL.

methods.name: public void connect(int connectTimeout, int readTimeout, int writeTimeout, List<ConnectionSpec> connectionSpecs, boolean connectionRetryEnabled) throws RouteException
private void connectSocket(int connectTimeout, int readTimeout, int writeTimeout, ConnectionSpecSelector connectionSpecSelector) throws IOException
methods.comment: Does all the work necessary to build a full HTTP or HTTPS connection on a raw socket.

methods.name: private void connectTls(int readTimeout, int writeTimeout, ConnectionSpecSelector connectionSpecSelector) throws IOException
private static synchronized TrustRootIndex trustRootIndex(SSLSocketFactory sslSocketFactory)
methods.comment:
* Returns a trust root index for {@code sslSocketFactory}. This uses a static, single-element
   * cache to avoid redoing reflection and SSL indexing in the common case where most SSL
   * connections use the same SSL socket factory.

methods.name: private void createTunnel(int readTimeout, int writeTimeout) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* To make an HTTPS connection over an HTTP proxy, send an unencrypted
   * CONNECT request to create the proxy connection. This may need to be
   * retried if the proxy requires authorization.

methods.name: private Request createTunnelRequest() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns a request that creates a TLS tunnel via an HTTP proxy, or null if
   * no tunnel is necessary. Everything in the tunnel request is sent
   * unencrypted to the proxy server, so tunnels include only the minimum set of
   * headers. This avoids sending potentially sensitive data like HTTP cookies
   * to the proxy unencrypted.

methods.name: boolean isConnected()
methods.comment: Returns true if {@link #connect} has been attempted on this connection.

methods.name: public boolean isHealthy(boolean doExtensiveChecks)
methods.comment: Returns true if this connection is ready to host new streams.

methods.name: public boolean isMultiplexed()
methods.comment:
* Returns true if this is a SPDY connection. Such connections can be used
   * in multiple HTTP requests simultaneously.
